fields.description: Issue includes local commentary and notebook-style columns about Miami’s winter season, tourism, nightlife, and civic affairs, with references to Florida politics and public officials. Substantial coverage and advertising relate to South Florida horse racing (Tropical Park and the upcoming Hialeah meet), including a handicapping/track-service promotion and racing-related notices. The issue also promotes the International Wine and Liquor Exposition in Miami and includes community notices such as a Disabled American Veterans Forget-Me-Not Day drive, alongside extensive local business and entertainment advertising.
